evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep digs into the fireplace concern with multiple follow-ups: 'could you tell me a little bit more about the exec?', 'could you describe it to me', 'does it have two little drawers', asks about weight, asks for picture. Multiple layers of detail extracted.

Personalized to this move: 'given that you don't have very many items, you just have real unique items' and special consideration time needed for fireplace protection.

top_strength: Outstanding two-layers-deep probing on the fireplace concern — rep persisted through multiple follow-ups to gather weight, dimensions, materials, and even looked up the specific Costco model to confirm capability, demonstrating genuine problem-solving for a complex item.
coaching_note: Section 2–5 are incomplete: rep never asked for broader concerns, never reflected them back, skipped the entire Two Promises section (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries coverage), never asked 'Does that feel fair?', and moved to booking with a softened ask ('at least reserve') instead of a direct, confident ask for the business — rebuild the full closing sequence.
